Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art animation sprite sheet, EXACTLY 3 columns by 3 rows, nine equally sized square cells on a 1536x1536 transparent canvas. Image 1 is the approved Elias PIXEL ART TURNAROUND and is the exact model to animate. Image 2 is the original identity reference only. Same character, exact golden parted hair shape, green eyes, dark forest vest, cream rolled sleeves, brown diagonal baldric, burgundy waist sash, charcoal trousers and dark boots. Sword stays FULLY SHEATHED on anatomical LEFT hip. Keep identical proportions, palette, hair volume, head size, body size, camera and clothing in EVERY cell. Gently elevated orthographic top-down RPG camera, original approved head size, NO perspective change. Genuine transparent background, no floor, no shadow, no frame borders, NO labels or numbers. Every full-body sprite fits INSIDE its cell with wide empty margins, feet near cell-bottom at the same ground height, head centered on the same local x axis; do not overlap neighboring cells. Character designed to be exported at 60 px tall into a 64x64 game cell, crisp low-resolution pixel clusters, no blur, no line smoothing. ALL NINE CELLS face the SAME specified direction below. The first eight cells are EIGHT DISTINCT consecutive poses of ONE seamless walk cycle in row-major order. Do not repeat the same pose. Natural modest alternating stride, boots lift clearly; arms counter-swing opposite the legs, bent elbows, one foot planted, body rise/fall very subtle (1 native px), sword/sash follow gently without changing sides. Same head/torso shapes and pixel patterns across frames to avoid shimmering. Frame sequence: row1col1 LEFT-foot forward contact, right foot back; row1col2 down/weight settling on left with right heel lifting; row1col3 passing right leg past planted left and arms near neutral; row2col1 rising, right knee moving ahead, left heel lifting; row2col2 RIGHT-foot forward contact, left foot back; row2col3 down/weight settling on right with left heel lifting; row3col1 passing left leg past planted right and arms near neutral; row3col2 rising, left knee moving ahead, right heel lifting ready to loop to first pose. Row3col3 is a NEUTRAL STANDING IDLE pose, both feet grounded shoulder width, relaxed hands. Render all 9 figures, full bodies including boots. Polished faithful JRPG pixel-art animation, compact readable details, NOT nine different character designs.
DIRECTION LOCK: SOUTH: walking toward the viewer / down the game screen. Face visible, both shoulders frontal, approved front sprite. Anatomical left sword is at viewer RIGHT. Arms and boots alternate forward/back in top-down projection.
